# NFL Daily — 2026-08-09 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 08/09: Commanders LT Laremy Tunsil (5x Pro Bowl) suffered a torn triceps in practice, will need surgery and miss most of the 2026 season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49564238/commanders-lt-laremy-tunsil-suffers-torn-triceps) — also [Garafolo](https://x.com/MikeGarafolo/status/2086244241269797046)
- 08/09: Raiders held QB Kirk Cousins and DE Maxx Crosby out of practice for a second straight day for disciplinary reasons after their Friday fight. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49561930/raiders-hold-cousins-crosby-practice-day-scuffle)
- 08/09: Panthers signed QB Kyle Trask as their No. 3 after Hall of Fame Game hero Haynes King is expected to miss time with a hamstring injury. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49567742/panthers-sign-kyle-trask-qb3-haynes-king-injury)
- 08/08: Pro Football Hall of Fame inducted its 2026 class in Canton, including Drew Brees, Larry Fitzgerald, and Luke Kuechly. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49562701/brees-fitzgerald-kuechly-enter-pro-football-hall-fame)
- 08/08: New Hall of Famer Roger Craig revealed a vascular dementia diagnosis during his induction speech, citing head injuries. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49562214/new-hall-famer-roger-craig-reveals-dementia-diagnosis)
- 08/09: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan said he's nearing full recovery from his July 14 car crash and plans to coach next week's preseason opener vs. the Titans. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49562792/kyle-shanahan-nears-full-strength-plans-coach-preseason-opener)
- 08/08: Eagles RT Lane Johnson (6x Pro Bowl) said 2026 will likely be his last NFL season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49561516/eagles-rt-lane-johnson-enters-season-farewell-mindset)
